# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Feb 10, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw significant progress in Rust workspace unification, bug fixes in alternative DA and configuration, and new tests for super root handling. Several new pull requests were opened, focusing on Kona service refactoring and L2 chain management.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Rust Workspace Unification and Tooling Updates
All separate Rust workspaces (`alloy-op-evm`, `alloy-op-hardforks`, `kona`, `op-alloy`, `op-reth`) were merged into a single unified workspace under `rust/`, streamlining development and removing redundant configuration files [#19034](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19034). This change also necessitated updates to `.semgrepignore` to reflect the new `rust/op-alloy/book` path [#19136](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19136). Additionally, `mise.toml` was updated to rename the deprecated `[alias]` section to `[tool_alias]` [#19137](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19137) and `semgrep` was upgraded from `1.90.0` to `1.137.0` to fix CI failures [#19121](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19121).

### Alternative Data Availability (DA) and Supernode Enhancements
A bug was fixed in the alternative DA manager to correctly handle cases where no commitments are available when the finalized head is updated [#18866](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18866). The `op-supernode/virtual_node` was updated to clarify L1 genesis handling for the genesis L2 block, ensuring it always returns L1 block 0 for flexibility in dispute game scenarios [#19114](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19114). A new test was added to `op-acceptance` to verify the challenger's behavior when the next super root is unavailable but the first chain has the next block on L1 [#19112](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19112).

### CI/CD and Dependency Updates
CircleCI utilities were updated to `v1.0.24`, which includes an upgrade to `mise` to `v2026.2.2` [#19129](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19129).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **Kona Service Refactoring:** Two pull requests aim to refactor the `kona-service` to improve testability of the derivation pipeline [#19141](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19141), [#19140](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19140).
- **L2 Chain Management and Configuration:** A feature to add `L2ProxyAdmin` was introduced for L2 chain management [#19135](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19135). Another PR adds a `rollup_config_override` feature for custom max sequencer drift in `kona-genesis` [#19131](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19131).
- **Bug Fixes and Minor Improvements:** A fix for websocket disconnections in `op-conductor` caused by incorrect timeout usage was proposed [#19134](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19134). Minor issues in the fetcher, metrics namespace, and README were addressed [#19126](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19126). A fix for CI to handle old and new workspace paths in the `op-reth-compact-codec` job was also opened [#19124](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19124).
- **Miscellaneous:** A change to increase the max gas limit to 50 G Gas was submitted [#19132](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19132). A chore to remove YAML anchors from CircleCI configs was also opened [#19139](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19139).
- **Dependency Bumps:** Updates for `op-rbuilder` to `v0.3.1` [#19127](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19127), `react-router` in `/rust/kona/docs` [#19123](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19123), and `hono` in `/rust/kona/docs` [#19122](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19122) were also initiated.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Dispute Game and Super Root Resolution
An issue related to reviewing correct trace output when the next super root is not found in `op-challenger` was closed [#18643](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18643). This issue was resolved by ensuring the super node trace provider works correctly and an integration test was added to confirm `op-challenger` and `op-program` alignment.

### Alternative DA and Proposer Stability
A bug where `op-proposer` failed with `GameAlreadyExists` due to a stalled finalized head in `op-alt-da` was closed [#18865](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18865). This fix improves the stability of the alternative data availability layer.

### Blob Priority Fee Tracking Activation
The issue concerning the activation of `op-batcher/txmgr` blob priority fee tracking was closed [#18737](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18737), indicating that the necessary steps for activation and monitoring were completed.

### Proxyd Error Handling
A bug where `proxyd` returned an error instead of `nil` when asked for a non-existent block was closed [#19133](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19133).

## NEW ISSUES

### Kona Hint Format Improvement
A new issue proposes using a binary format for Kona hints instead of string serialization to improve efficiency and correctness, moving from a `Hint -> String -> Bytes -> String -> Hint` flow to `Hint -> Bytes -> Hint` [#19125](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19125).

### op-reth Performance and Stability Concerns
An issue was opened regarding `op-reth` being blocked waiting for an execution cache mutex or experiencing OOM errors when pruning is enabled [#19128](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19128).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### op-conductor: SEGFAULT during Leader Election
The issue [#13363](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/13363) regarding `op-conductor` experiencing SEGFAULTs when a peer is killed during leader election remains active. The latest comment confirms the problem is still present in the current version, particularly when sequencers are paused during migration from single to HA setups, causing snapshotting issues. Previous discussions suggested that invalid data might be written to raft logs or snapshot files, potentially due to insufficient log capacity or issues during initial cluster bootstrapping. The community is looking for ways to prevent SEGFAULTs and avoid pausing conductors during initial unsafe head information commitment.

### Follow-up for Blob Tip Oracle Activation
Issue [#18618](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18618), a follow-up to activate the blob tip oracle, was reopened. The issue was previously closed but still has a `TODO` referencing it in the codebase. The activation of the blob tip oracle is pending confirmation in production that `newBlobSavings == true` occurs most of the time to justify its use.

### Support for Multiple Sequencer RPC Endpoints
The discussion on issue [#763](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/763) about supporting multiple sequencer RPC endpoints for transaction forwarding is ongoing. While the proposed change is backward compatible and aims to prevent outages caused by single endpoint failures, there's a debate about whether providing multiple URLs is the most user-friendly approach. An alternative suggestion is to leverage existing web2 reliability solutions for a single URL, as the ultimate goal is to ensure data reaches the same sequencer.
